label: run139 measured-2023 load credit (prior keeper)
definition: (SUPERSEDED by run142) KEEPER. run134's recipe with the full measured-2023 picture: measured storage AS (1.25 GW, via storage_as_commitment, all years) + the measured 2023 load-resource RRS-UFR reserve credit (884 MW; load-RRS-from-year=2023), on the run133/134 derate-correct outages. Storage-RESERVE credit stays scoped from 2025 (crediting 2023/24 storage reserve double-relaxes — run137 27.0). Result: 2023 43.1 (MAE 12.1, tail 129/73), 2024 33.8, 2025 38.0 vs actual 48.4(181/104)/26.8(53/16)/32.5(31/3). The decisive finding: the measured 2023 storage over-tightens 2023 via the commitment (uncredited 58.4, run138, over actual), and the measured 2023 load credit corrects it to the best 2023 MAE (12.1 vs 16.0) — the brief's 'measured 2023 reserves + correct derates' combination. Honest caveats: 2023 now slightly UNDER on avg/tail (the two measured effects bracket actual, no fitting); 2024/2025 stay hot (the separate co-opt-adder over-fire in comfortable years, run131, out of scope here).
